title: Quote: I have a great respect for incremental improvement, and I've...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Steve Jobs in 1994: The Rolling Stone Interview
content: I have a great respect for incremental improvement, and I've done that sort of thing in my life, but I've always been attracted to the more revolutionary changes. I don't know why. Because they're harder. They're much more stressful emotionally. And you usually go through a period where everybody tells you that you've completely failed.
